verdict.rationale: Ubuntu Desktop's own documentation lists the AT-SPI DBus interfaces (org.a11y.atspi.Accessible, org.a11y.atspi.Action) and a Linux command-line tutorial. These are programmatic ways to inspect and drive the desktop, but only as thin index mentions with no parity claim. Nothing shows that everything doable in the UI is also exposed programmatically. Missing for 10: any documented claim or evidence of UI/API parity, a documented general-purpose desktop/settings API, coverage depth of the CLI/DBus surfaces, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
